label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) is alert-TP. The sink at line 22 (response.getWriter().println(param)) outputs user-controlled data ('param') to an HTML response without encoding. While guarded by a check on the authenticated principal name (lines 18-21), this guard does not sanitize the input. An attacker authenticating as a principal starting with 'svc_' can supply malicious script in the 'BenchmarkTest' parameter, leading to reflection. The resolved sink value is the raw user input from request.getParameter.

evidence.note: User input 'param' retrieved from request.getParameter flows directly to response.getWriter().println without HTML encoding.
